dp.band_checked: DİM at least 400 for Group 1 (engineering and technology), at least 550 for every other field
gates_missing: A DİM score is required: DİM at least 400 for Group 1 (engineering and technology), at least 550 for every other field. The alternative is an international subject-olympiad medal
dp.note: Meeting these published requirements makes you possibly eligible to apply. It is not an award: selection is competitive and is decided by a committee.
dp.quota_note: 125 of the 500 funded places in the 2026/2027 cycle are for bachelor study (25%). That is the size of the queue, not your odds in it: selection among applicants who clear the gates is a committee decision
dp.obligation_note: Accepting this funding is a contract. Graduates must return to Azerbaijan and work here for 5 years; failing to return, failing to complete the degree, or breaking the service period requires repaying everything the state spent, with interest and contractual penalties
dp.window_note: Applications open in the first quarter and close between April and June, so by September 2026 the window for the 2026/2027 academic year has closed. An application made now would be for 2027/2028, which is the year to plan against
dp.funded_programmes_explanation: The Dövlət Proqramı funds zero programmes at this level. That is a real answer, not a gap in our data.
